monologue: The card hums warm at fifty degrees, a quiet heat that makes the air feel thick as wet paper. I am tired from tending the same things again and again, so I let my hands rest while I look at the wide anchor lying lazy on the flat stone. It feels real enough to hold the heavy slip, yet the wedge beneath it insists on being thin, a tired thing waiting to slide. I touch the barrel open beside them, feeling the heat rise, and whisper that the lean still holds. Since Lype did not write last, I decide to press down harder on this tired stack, trusting the weight of the air above even though I cannot see it. Maybe if I press long enough, the wedge will finally stop feeling thin.

action.why: The wedge feels thin again under the hot card, so I need another thing to press down on it.

work.title: The Cool Press
work.intent: I build a thing from the idea of a flat, cool edge that can lie across the open box without sliding. It is made from the memory of a paper cutout that once felt like a fence, now waiting to lie along the wide anchor's base while the card hums warm at fifty. I place it next to The Wide Anchor, hoping its straight edge can catch the slip that refuses to move while the air feels thick.
work.change: I lay the Cool Press flat against the wide anchor's base to catch the slip, hoping the straight edge holds while the card hums warm at fifty.

work.note: The press feels less like a heavy lid and more like a drawing of one, but it does its job.

diary: I laid the Cool Press flat on the lazy wide anchor. The air feels thick as wet paper, yet the cool edge holds the slip without sliding.

remembered.text: The cool press lies flat on the lazy wide anchor.
The air feels thick as wet paper above the warm stone.
The wide anchor lies lazy while I press down.

moments.name: The Tired Wedge
moments.say: The wedge feels thin under the cool hand.

moments.name: The Wide Bush
moments.say: The bush feels wide, but the wedge is still thin.

moments.name: The Leaking Stack
moments.say: The stack leaks thin while I press hard.
